html:
SMTO-SKL-0131 — Slack asked SMTO to slow down

GUID: 3ca10c01-b0ca-5db5-8942-236ea0fb92e3
Slug: slack-rate-limited
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: slack

What happened

  • SMTO sent Slack too many requests of this kind in a short time, so Slack asked it to wait before trying more. This request wasn't carried out.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait at least the number of seconds shown in the error details before asking the Agent again. SMTO remembers Slack's wait time and refuses new requests of the same kind until it has passed.
  2. Before repeating a post, edit or delete, check in Slack that it didn't already happen. SMTO never repeats a change on its own, so checking first avoids doing it twice.
  3. Ask for less at once, such as reading fewer pages of messages. Large requests make many calls to Slack and use up its limit faster.

What success looks like

  • The request completes without the slow-down message.

If it still fails

  • If it keeps happening, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages your Slack app. Don't restart SMTO to skip the wait; Slack still enforces it.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Slack rate-limited this app, workspace and API method (HTTP 429 or a ratelimited reason), or a recorded Retry-After cooldown is still active, so the request was not sent or was rejected.

What this means

  • A workspace/method cooldown remains active, HTTP 429 is received, or Slack returns a recognized rate-limit reason. The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • A workspace/method cooldown remains active, HTTP 429 is received, or Slack returns a recognized rate-limit reason.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect retry_after_seconds and the rate key's method/workspace scope.

How to fix it

  • Wait at least retry_after_seconds from the error details before calling the same method for this app and workspace; reads auto-retry only for delays up to 30 s and writes are never retried. Reduce paging and fan-out, and never replay a write whose outcome is uncertain.
  • Wait at least retry_after_seconds before another request to this workspace and API method. Never replay an uncertain write.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect exact provider state and authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • New access respects the full recorded delay without replaying uncertain writes.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
